item.text:
Fixed `prices.py`: the cache now uses `(product, currency)` keys instead of product alone. The handler still returns `{"amount": ...}`.

Added a regression test covering currency switching, separate products, repeated cache hits, and zero prices. It failed before the fix and passed afterward using Python’s standard-library `unittest`. `git diff --check` also passed.
